player_prompt.intro:
Uyisebenzisa {player_id} kwiNim.
Inhloso yakho kukuthatha iselwano esiphela.
Kula mazwe onke, khetha ngumgangatho mnye kuphela bese ususe izinto ezininzi.
Sebenzisa uhlobo '[pile quantity]', lapho umgangatho ngowakho nomgangatho, kanti ingxakiyo ngengxaki yezinto zisuswe.
Njengoko, '[0 3]' isusa izinto ezintathu zomgangatho 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Akukho fomathi yokutshintsha ifumanekileyo. Sebenzisa '[pile quantity]'.

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
